status_note: LD-merlin-ue (2026-09-29): UE import of the Merlin look-dev run (merlin-h2-lookdev/1: H2.1 rig + UV1, concept-toned BC, MatID, class LUT, EdgeMask) onto M_UM_Figure_v2 through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt. The figure MI is a child of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (MatID, hero LUT 16x16, EdgeMask, UV1 in metres); the base keeps M_UM_BaseMarker (team band). At most «технически импортировано / измерено»; no art acceptance, no budget (GD-058 open); Blue/Red diagnostic pair (Q-304 open). Rev 2 (look-dev C, group A, 2026-09-30): master v2.1 UseTeamAccent with the TeamAccent mask of the look-dev run (library_inputs.TeamAccent: belt, hood lining, cuff bands, hem edge; 5.22 % of the figure), one gain rule for both teams (TeamDyeGain 0.8 / Y_p50 + TeamDyeCeiling 0.9 / Y_p95), teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision «Акценты + кольцо»: the robe stays concept blue in both teams); the deprecated W4-B TeamMask is no longer imported (TeamMaskTexture = T_UM_Mask_Black, team_color_mode none); MI names Neutral / P1 / P2 / DebugClass (+ DebugZones). The mesh stays on the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/Merlin/Rig/SK_Merlin_Skeleton.
